title: Guidelines on base amounts for pecuniary sanctions

paras.text: AMLA’s open public consultations are open to all stakeholders with an interest in the EU’s anti-money laundering and countering the financing of terrorism (AML/CFT) framework.

Public input on these draft Guidelines is essential to ensure that the proposed approach provides an appropriate starting point for ensuring effective, proportionate and dissuasive pecuniary sanctions.

The Guidelines establish a common approach for determining the base amount of pecuniary sanctions imposed in case of breaches of AML/CFT requirements and thereby set out how supervisors should take into account the severity of the breach, the legal form and category of the obliged entity concerned, and use a relevant financial metric.

Targeted to supervisors across both the financial and non-financial sectors, the Guidelines will foster greater convergence in AML/CFT enforcement throughout the Union. By promoting a consistent approach to the determination of base amounts, they aim to reduce divergences in enforcement practices across jurisdictions, while supporting effective, proportionate and dissuasive pecuniary sanctions.
The Guidelines do not cover the subsequent adjustments that may be made to reflect aggravating or mitigating circumstances when determining the final amount of a pecuniary sanction.
A Public Hearing on the draft Guidelines is planned for Tuesday, 12 January 2027, from 10:00 to 12:00 CET. Please click the button below to register.
